title: Irin kek: ƙwanƙwasa ɗan gajeren ɓawon burodi, ƙwanƙwasa mai kauri da faɗuwar choux

say: Irin kek: ɗan gajeren ɓawon burodi, ƙwanƙwasa mai laushi, da kuma choux mara kyau.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module uku na Advanced Baking and Pastry.
Kek yana ba da lada madaidaicin sarrafa zafin jiki. Shortcrust snaps saboda sanyi mai yana rage alkama.

say: Yi amfani da ma'auni daidai na gari da man shanu mai sanyi. Jefa cubes na man shanu a cikin gari, amma kar a shafa su a ciki. Ana son dunƙule duka.

say: Don tunawa. Ci gaba da ɗan gajeren crust sanyi kuma sanya shi cikin kwano. Ka ba da ƙwanƙwasa harafi huɗu masu ninki huɗu kuma ka sa man shanu ya yi sanyi. A bushe manna choux kuma yi amfani da gwajin V.
Cike custard da sauri. Kuma nemo kurakurai cikin tsari: rabo, zafin jiki, kulawa, sannan yin burodi.
